source: Rigid-body kinematics u=t+omega cross x has zero infinitesimal strain. A disconnected loaded elastic body or support rows of rank below six must fail necessary preflight; solver finish/finite displacement alone cannot establish stability.
geometry: Two independently meshed unit cubes, zero-gap interface; C3D10 0.6/0.4 m, immutable body/face/node identities
supports: Detached case supports x=0 body only; connected rank-deficient case has only ux on x=0. No weak springs/stabilization or silent constraint removal.
loads: Axial +x force 1e6 N on second body's far face, only for controlled native diagnostic; application must refuse before solve admission
expected: All invalid cases refuse with specific support/connectivity/dependency/native diagnostics. A preflight pass is necessary only and never a proof of stiffness rank/stability. Actual native failure transcripts, including finite outputs if produced, are diagnostic only.
numerical_policy: No displacement magnitude threshold is invented to classify instability. Native singular/pivot/indefinite/mode messages fail; even finite outputs cannot override failed topology/support/MPC or frozen equilibrium gates.
exclusions: No general eigenspectrum/stiffness-rank or arbitrary assembly stability certification. Product mortar remains one full axis-aligned planar zero-gap unit-square interface, <=65 trace nodes per side; physical gaps, multiple solver bonds and transformed constraints remain blocked.
